name: matlab-fit-tire-model
description: Fit a tire model (Magic Formula 6.2/5.2/5.1, Dugoff, or Fiala) to measured tire force and moment data using the Vehicle Dynamics Blockset Extended Tire Features API (tireData.import, tireModel.new, tireModel.fit, tireModel.export). Use when fitting, parameterizing, or calibrating a tire model from tire measurement data (TYDEX, Calspan, MTS, or text/CSV from any test source), creating a .tir file, or building a Magic Formula tire model from test data. Also use for the individual steps: importing TYDEX, Calspan, MTS, or CSV tire data (file extensions `.tdx` for TYDEX; `.data`, `.tim`, `.rsp` for MTS; any other extension read as text) into a tireData object, exporting a tire model to .tir, inspecting, smoothing, cropping, or plotting tire measurement data or a model's response, or converting a fitted model to another type.
